thread:
eva_billing: Ping — Quasar Bio flagged renewal INV-2026-900: platform fee increased to $30k from the contracted $20k. They attached SOW-2024-58 which clearly shows $20k/year and a signed amendment EX-2025-03 that freezes fees for term. cc @noel_acct

noel_acct: Looking. Invoice generated 2026-04-02. System shows platform_fee=30000. I suspect mapping to global default after their legacy fee code expired.

pricing-bot: Pricing lookup: customer quasar-bio has fee_override=null; tier_lookup returned default_platform_fee=30000. Amendment EX-2025-03 not surfaced because amendment effective_date stored as 0000-00-00 in contract_db due to parsing error. Ticket PRICING-460 created.

eva_billing: Can we hold collection and issue provisional credit while legal confirms amendment validity? Quasar is threatening to pause and request termination.

billing-bot: Invoice lines for INV-2026-900:
- PLATFORM_FEE: 30000
- SUPPORT_STANDARD: 10,000
- USAGE: 5,600
Total: 45,600

noel_acct: Draft remediation: 1) Issue provisional credit CM-2026-311 for $10,000 to revert to contracted $20k. 2) Mark invoice as disputed and hold payment. 3) Run backfill to re-apply amendment flags and regenerate invoice. Need CFO approval for credits > $5k.

carter_cfo: Approve provisional credit of $10,000 pending reconciliation. Require audit entry with contract scan and root cause. Also authorize a $2,000 goodwill credit to smooth the relationship, if needed.

amanda_legal: I'll validate EX-2025-03. If amendment is valid, recommend immediate correction and a short note to the customer. If amendment shows any ambiguity, escalate.

eva_billing: Issuing CM-2026-311 ($10,000) and CM-2026-312 ($2,000 goodwill). Billing-bot, please attach contract PDF and PRICING-460 link to memos and flag as provisional.

billing-bot: Created CM-2026-311 and CM-2026-312; status pending_controller_approval. Attached contract image and PRICING-460.

pricing-bot: Suggested follow-up: update contract-parser to handle legacy amendment date formats and add regression tests. Assign to eng-pricing as PRICING-460. Also add a data-quality sweep to find other customers with amendment_parse=null.

noel_acct: Draft customer message:

"""
Hi Quasar team,

Thanks for flagging INV-2026-900. We discovered an internal parsing issue that prevented your signed amendment from being applied to renewal pricing. We've placed the invoice on hold and issued a provisional credit to restore your contracted platform fee. We'll send an updated invoice and a reconciliation report within 2 business days. Apologies for the disruption.

Best, Noel (Account)
"""

eva_billing: Logging this thread for audit. Follow-up: confirm regenerated invoice and close PRICING-460 before finalizing credits.
